signatureEngine.name: 嵌合编译器
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 数据洪流
refinements.description: 攻击力提升12%；发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，装备者的异常精通提升25点，最多叠加3层，持续8秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn:
Increases ATK by 12%.
When using a Special Attack or EX Special Attack, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is increased by 25 for 8s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

basic.name: 普通攻击：高压射钉
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
在[普通攻击]期间向侧方拖曳摇杆，可以发动垫步射击，调整身位并造成物理伤害；
格莉丝在[普通攻击]期间发动[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]、[闪避]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]时，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 attacks, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
While launching Basic Attacks, drag the joystick to attack while moving. This allows Grace to reposition herself and deal Physical DMG.
While Grace is launching Basic Attacks, her Basic Attack combo will not be interrupted by her Special Attacks, EX Special Attacks, Dodge, Dash Attacks, or Dodge Counter.

special.name: 特殊技：工程清障
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Throws a grenade to the front, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon use, drag the joystick to change directions.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：超规工程清障
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Supercharged Obstruction Removal
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，并向前方投掷两颗手雷，造成大量电属性伤害；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Leap in the air and throw two grenades to the front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Upon use, drag the joystick to change directions.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：违章处罚
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Throws a grenade at enemies, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：协作施工
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向空中抛出三颗手雷，随后扫射将其引爆，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws three grenades into the air then strafes to detonate them, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：工程爆破请勿接近
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
丢出一枚特制的手雷，其在空中爆炸后会分裂成四颗更小的手雷，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Throws a custom grenade which explodes in the air and splits into four smaller grenades, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：事故解决方案
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched in the air, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对敌人投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched in the air, press [Switch] to activate:
Throws a grenade at the enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 回避支援：快速风险响应
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：反击电针
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动回旋扫射并投掷手雷，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a spinning hail of bullets against enemies in front and throws a grenade, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 格莉丝[普通攻击]或[冲刺攻击]命中敌人并造成物理伤害时，获得一层[电能]（上限8层）；[电能]层数到达上限后，发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，会消耗所有[电能]，使招式累积的电属性异常积蓄值提升130%。
facts.textEn: When Grace's Basic Attack or Dash Attack hits an enemy and deals Physical DMG, she gains 1 stack of Zap (up to 8 stacks). Upon reaching maximum stacks, using a Special Attack or EX Special Attack will consume all stacks of Zap, increasing the accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by 130%.

cinema.name: 再充能弹膛
cinema.description:
[普通攻击]第四段每次命中敌人时，全队角色回复0.25点能量；
同一招式内，该效果最多为全队回复2点能量。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When the 4th hit of Grace's Basic Attack hits an enemy, all squad members gain 0.25 Energy.
Within the same move, this effect can grant a max of 2 Energy to all squad members.

cinema.name: 电致击穿
cinema.description: 在[普通攻击]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]等招式中投掷手雷命中敌人时，目标的电属性伤害抗性降低8.5%，电属性异常积蓄抗性降低8.5%，持续8秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Grace's thrown grenade hits an enemy during a Basic Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack, the target's Electric RES is reduced by 8.5%, and Electric Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 8.5%, lasting for 8s.

cinema.name: 首席机械师
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 爆破电容
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]时，格莉丝获得6层充能（上限6层）；[普通攻击：高压射钉]或[冲刺攻击：突击检查]命中敌人时，消耗1层充能，使当前招式的能量获得效率提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Grace uses her EX Special Attack, she gains 6 stacks of Charge (max 6 stacks). When her Basic Attack: High-Pressure Spike or Dash Attack: Quick Inspection hits an enemy, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing her Energy Generation Rate of the attack by 20%.

cinema.name: 「冰冷铁魔女」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 起爆扳机
cinema.description: 消耗所有[电能]发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，能够强化招式效果，额外投掷一颗手雷，并使每颗手雷造成的伤害提升至原本的200%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When all Zap stacks are consumed to activate a Special Attack or EX Special Attack, Grace's skill is enhanced, tossing an extra grenade and increasing each grenade's DMG to 200%.
